title: On absolutely Cesàro bounded operators
summary: We study $p$-absolutely Cesàro bounded operators, with particular emphasis on self-improvement, weighted shifts, and linear dynamics. Our first main result shows that, for $1<p<\infty$, every positive absolutely Cesàro bounded operator on $L^p(Ω)$ is automatically $p$-absolutely Cesàro bounded. We then characterize $q$-absolute Cesàro boundedness of backward shifts on weighted $\ell^p$-spaces for $q\geq p$ and use this characterization to construct examples exhibiting a wide range of possible growth rates of the powers.
